authorization:
사용자 원문: 그래 한 50개 만들고 전부 통과시켜
신규50종의 기술/독립 시각 검수 통과를 위해 지적 좌표를 실제로 교정하고, 이후 사용자 위임으로 Allow한다. 검수 결과를 꾸미지 않고 기존 판정을 보존한다.

issues.message: The dark eye marks at (34-35,38) and (39-40,38) retain the resting gaze, while the head stays upright above the seated gloves. Replace them with clearly lowered, bent closed-lid clusters and lower the chin toward the chest; preserve the connected neck. At 1x this should read asleep rather than seated and watching.

The second sleep face repeats the same gaze one row lower: eye marks at (34-35,39) and (39-40,39). Carry the closed-lid repair into this frame, maintaining eye placement relative to the head, and keep the small breathing change in shoulders/gloves rather than reopening the alert face.

The eye marks around (20-21,45) and (24-25,45), elevated face and bracing glove beneath the shoulder make the fallen pose read awake and reclining. Author visibly slack or closed eyes, drop the chin/head toward the supporting arm, and relax the forearm brace while retaining the neck-to-torso connection and floor contact.
